known_issues: Client profile data in client's section does not save; page refreshes repeatedly without persisting changes.

existing_features.title: Fix the client profile “Save Required Information” action so it updates an existing client profile instead of calling the backend method intended only for initial profile creation, and ensure the save action does not trigger a full page reload/refresh.

Update the frontend Client Profile page to use the new client-profile update mutation for saving required fields, and ensure React Query cache invalidation/refetch updates the UI state without navigation loops.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a dedicated backend update method for client required profile fields (names, yearOfBirth, idNumber, mobileNumber/phoneNumber, pinnedLocation) that validates input and updates the caller’s existing client profile record without requiring profile re-creation.

projectName: Fix client profile save loop (persist client profile updates instead of refreshing)
